passage.label: Indeed these disbelievers love immediate leave behind grave Day; created them strengthened forms when will change likenesses complete alteration; Indeed reminder whoever wills take Lord way; not will except Allah wills Indeed Allah ever Knowing Wise; admits wills mercy wrongdoers prepared painful punishment

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمٗا ثَقِيلٗا
نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا
إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا
وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا

mainSubject.label: Disbelievers' love of the immediate and abandonment of the grave Day exposed; their creation and strengthened forms noted alongside divine power to alter their likenesses completely; the whole named a reminder enabling whoever wills to take a way to his Lord, yet willing occurs only by Allah's will since He is Knowing and Wise; He admits whom He wills into mercy while preparing painful punishment for the wrongdoers

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the disbelievers' chains-shackles-blaze preparation (4) before the righteous-reward block opens (5); P2 ends with the earned-reward declaration (22) before the progressive-Quran and prophetic-instruction block begins (23); P3 covers the tanzil, patience command, dhikr and night worship (23-26); P4 runs through the immediate-love diagnosis, creation-alteration power, reminder function, divine-will nesting and closing mercy-punishment distinction (27-31).
